prediction.derivation: Softmax depends only on logit differences. Writing logits = W a + b with W of shape (C, h_last), the map is invariant under W -> W + 1_C u^T for any u in R^{h_last} and b -> b + c 1_C. That is a subspace of dimension h_last + 1, and it does not depend on C. Each sample supplies C-1 independent logit-difference constraints, giving rank n(C-1) until the gauge-quotiented parameter space P - g is saturated. The free subspace is the kernel minus the gauge.
prediction.falsifier: Any cell where measured d_free != max(0, P - (h_last+1) - n*(C-1)).
prediction.novel_content_of_this_freeze: The C-independence of g and the (C-1) multiplier are both derived here and NOT measured yet. The binary case previously confirmed reduces to C=2 and cannot distinguish g = h+1 from other forms, nor n from n(C-1). Multi-class is therefore a genuine out-of-sample test of the derivation.
prediction.pass_criterion: EXACT integer agreement between measured d_free and the formula in every cell. Any single mismatch fails the prediction.
prediction.status: frozen before any multi-class or multi-depth measurement
